title: Watch: New Pentagon UFO Files Drop Warship Video And Skinwalker Ranch Secrets
description: The Department of War’s eighth batch of UFO files, out Friday, carries a 2020 infrared clip from the Middle East in which a tiny object glowing white hot appears to fly across the bow of a warship, according to files and footage the Daily Mail obtained ahead of the release. — Ross Ibbetson (@IbbetsonRoss) November 20, 2026 The drop runs to about 40 documents and three videos. The videos were chosen because the Pentagon’s own analysts still can’t resolve them, and the batch takes the total number of records released since the archive opened in May past 500. The bigger find is on paper: for the first time, the government owns up to the “Ten Month Report,” the 538-page Skinwalker Ranch dossier written by Pentagon contractor Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS). Handed to the Defense Intelligence Agency in July 2009, it sketches a buried 5,000-square-foot vault, with walls three feet thick, to keep “exotic material or tissue” BAASS hoped to acquire.
